# bss layout for PAL/main, consumed by tools/scripts/gen_bss.py.
#
# The original link placed these objects immediately after .data.  Every
# address here was reached only through a %hi/%lo pair in .text, so the
# build verifies the layout to the byte: a wrong offset changes instruction
# bytes and `make check` fails.
#
# Sizes are derived from the gap to the next referenced address, so they are
# upper bounds on the true object size, never lower bounds.  Unreferenced
# space is emitted as anonymous padding.
#
# Columns: original-vram  symbol  size.  `.` in the symbol column is padding.
